notes.title: DDLC Fan Forge Best Girl Challenge
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30715674/300c7a62f55208ef144590e2c439aa9f4a32f2ac.png[/img]

[h3]Your fellow Literature Club members are hosting a special "Best Girl Challenge" through the [url=https://twitter.com/forfansxfans]@ForFansxFans[/url] DDLC Fan Forge! But it seems something's amiss...

Oh my! The club members are jealous that Monika is always the most popular! It looks like they've taken over this contest and aren't letting Monika steal the show this time. Fair is fair... Or is it? 

Help determine the outcome by submitting your original art of your favorite club member, and by voting!

Winning artists will have their fan art officially licensed and receive exclusive prizes from Team Salvato and For Fans By Fans.[/h3]

[h2]Contest Link[/h2]
[h3][url=http://bit.ly/Best_Girl_Challenge_FF]http://bit.ly/Best_Girl_Challenge_FF[/url][/h3]

[h2]Deadline to Submit[/h2]
[h3]November 12, 2020 @ 11:59 PT[/h3]

[h2]How to Play[/h2]
[h3][b]Submit artwork[/b] of your favorite girl or girls to give them [b]10 points![/b]
[b]Vote on artwork[/b] of your favorite girl or girls to give them [b]1 point![/b][/h3]

notes.title: DDLC v1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
DDLC has been updated to v1.1.1.

[list]
[*]Game will no longer behave unexpectedly following a game crash (progress is properly saved).
[*]"Auto" mode now disables when a poem is displayed on-screen so that it is not skipped over by accident.
[*]Fixed minor continuity issues during the third poem-sharing session in some instances.
[*]Monika will now still show you her poem during a scene with Natsuki that previously made her skip over it.
[*]Fixed an issue where right-clicking during certain scenes would cause the scene to pause and ruin the timing.
[*]Other minor fixes and enhancements for typos, image sprites, and time-sensitive events.
[/list]

No new game content has been added, hidden or otherwise.
